newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks slide ahead of public holiday.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks slide ahead of public holiday.

text.p: The Madrid bourse posted one of its biggest falls this year on Thursday, after being dragged lower by losses on Wall Street. Dealers said the short-term outlook was uncertain. * General index slipped 16.50 points, 2.69 percent, to 596.26. * Ibex-35 index fell 202.83 points, 2.91 percent, to 6,756.09. * Turnvoer was lower than in previous sessions with 73.3 billion pesetas changing hands.
"The instability of this morning, the falls on Wall Street and the holiday on Friday prompted heavy selling," one dealer said.
The Madrid bourse will be closed on Friday for a local holiday.
Among individual stocks, Telefonica fell 3.44 percent to 4,065, while Repsol fell 2.20 percent to 6,230.
Endesa fell 1.9 percent. The government announced the details of the sale of a stake in the electricity group on Thursday which analysts said presented no surprises.
